title: Allow changing IP range for shared connections in the GUI
line: The IPv4 tab of a shared connection now lets you set its IP range, and saving no longer erases a range set with nmcli.
explanation: With the method set to "Shared to other computers", the IPv4 editor disabled the address table and its Add/Remove buttons, treating Shared like Link-Local. Because the editor only writes addresses from an enabled table, every save sent ipv4 with no addresses, wiping a range set with nmcli and making NetworkManager fall back to 10.42.0.1. The change keeps the table enabled for Shared (NetworkManager uses its first address as the shared subnet) in both the widget editor and the QML editor, and validates rows there without requiring one.

commits.message:
editor/ipv4: allow setting the address range of shared connections

The address table was disabled for "Shared to other computers", so the
range could not be set and any address set elsewhere was dropped on every
save. Keep the table enabled for Shared, as NetworkManager uses it.

BUG: 422694

media.caption: Shared connection with 192.168.77.1/24: address table and Add/Remove greyed out
Same connection: the address table is editable for Shared

reviews.text: Enabling the IPv4 address table for the Shared method in both the QtWidgets editor and the QML editor cleanly fixes both setting custom shared subnets in the GUI and preserving ranges configured via nmcli on save. Validation properly checks any entered rows without requiring one for Shared, and the screenshots plus dbusmock payload checks verify both preservation and editing without regressing Link-Local.

Correct root cause: the IPv4 editor treated Shared like Link-Local, disabled the address table, and setting() only writes addresses from an enabled table, so the range could not be set and an nmcli range was dropped on save. Enabling the table for Shared in both the widget editor and the QML editor, with rows validated but not required, matches NetworkManager (first address = shared subnet, empty = 10.42.0.1 default). The evidence shows the stored range loaded, editable and sent in the Update payload, and Link-Local still greys out. Nit: the isValid() condition in ipv4widget.cpp ('Manual || Shared' then '&& Manual') would read more clearly as a separate empty-row check for Manual.
